summary: Retested the iteration_3 fix: fall back from the own Gemini key to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. On the first run the fix did NOT work: 3 of 6 tests failed. The own GEMINI_API_KEY still returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and the code falls back as intended. But the fallback call ALSO failed: _gemini_once always calls with_params(reasoning_effort='low'), and with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY the request goes through litellm's openai-compatible provider, which raises UnsupportedParamsError for reasoning_effort. So /api/diagnose returned 503, and review/caption translation silently stored the original text. I applied a one-line fix in server.py: send reasoning_effort only with the own key. After that, all 6 of 6 pass. /api/diagnose returns 200 with title_es/title_it/difficulty. GET ?lang=it returns an Italian description and title, cached in i18n. Portfolio caption_es is translated (IT->ES). Review comment_it is translated: 'Muy buen trabajo, rápido y limpio' became 'Ottimo lavoro, veloce e pulito'. The 503 status is confirmed: the JSON detail reaches the client through the proxy. fmtDate now uses day/month '2-digit' (code reviewed only). All test data was deleted.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT. The fallback to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY failed with litellm.UnsupportedParamsError: 'openai does not support parameters: [reasoning_effort]' for model gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview. A standalone check confirmed it: Emergent key + reasoning_effort fails, Emergent key without it gives 'Ottimo lavoro'. Fix at server.py:60-64: apply with_params(reasoning_effort='low') only when api_key != EMERGENT_KEY.

minor.issue: Every AI call still tries the used-up own key first, so each request pays an extra failed round-trip of about 1s and adds a 429 warning to the log. Consider remembering the 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED state (for example, skip the own key for N minutes or until the UTC day resets).
If translation fails, the original text is stored in both _es and _it and never retried. This is how the regression went unnoticed: the endpoints returned 200 while translation was broken.

action_items: Review and keep the testing agent's fix in server.py _gemini_once: reasoning_effort is applied only for the own GEMINI_API_KEY. If you restructure it, do NOT send reasoning_effort with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
Optional: skip the own key temporarily after a 429 to avoid the extra latency on every call.
Optional: log or flag translation failures (for example, leave comment_it unset) so they are visible and can be retried.

rca_of_issue: Reproduce: POST /api/diagnose returns 503. The backend log shows 'own Gemini key failed ... 429' and then 'UnsupportedParamsError: openai does not support parameters: [reasoning_effort]'. Cause: emergentintegrations routes the Emergent key through litellm's openai provider (model gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview), which does not accept reasoning_effort. Mitigation: apply reasoning_effort only for the direct Gemini key. Verified with a standalone script and the full pytest run.
